title: Dan Hicks' wife Hannah Storm posts on death of NBC voice: 'His loss is immeasurable'
text:
Dan Hicks wife Hannah Storm writes about death of NBC announcer NFL NBA NHL MLB WNBA Outdoors Casinos Newsletter SPORTS Dan Hicks' wife Hannah Storm posts on death of NBC voice: 'His loss is immeasurable'
 Charles Curtis For The Win Nov. 12, 2026, 9:52 a.m. ET Dan Hicks, the legendary voice of so many sporting events for NBC from Notre Dame football to golf to the Olympics, died at the age of 64, according to NBC Sports and his wife, fellow broadcaster Hannah Storm.
 "Dan was truly one of a kind and, quite simply, the person everyone wanted to be around," Storm wrote on social media. "When he walked into a room, he brough the energy, the laughter and the people together. He was endlessly kind, thoughtful and funny, and he made everyone feel like they mattered."
 NBC Sports also released a statement on Thursday, which read in part: "Dan Hicks was an extraordinary colleague, friend and person. In his 34 years at NBC Sports, he was an exceptional storyteller and caller of games and events who elevated some of the biggest moments in sports history."
 What was Dan Hicks' cause of death?
 Nothing officially has been said, but Storm said in her Instagram post that Hicks died "following an acute illness."
